responsibility: Provides the AVR backend’s internal diagnostic logging facility used by target developers rather than end users. It implements the `avr_dump`/`avr_edump`/`avr_fdump` style formatted printers declared in `avr-protos.h`, with custom format codes for GCC trees, RTL, machine modes, register classes, locations, pass information, and current function context, and it parses the `-mlog=` option into the `avr_log` flag set so specific backend subsystems such as address costing, builtin expansion, constraints, and progmem/address legalization can selectively emit debug traces.
